title: Add reusable component instances and layout constraints
summary: Without component instances, variants, constraints, and override semantics, edits cannot express design-system consistency or safely map back to repo-owned components.
acceptance_criteria: Definitions and instances have stable IDs, schema-versioned payloads, source/reference revisions, variant axes, named slots, allowed overrides, and deterministic fallback for missing definitions.
Constraints support pinned edges, fixed/fill/hug sizing, min/max bounds, alignment, spacing, and nested stack layout with deterministic geometry independent from SwiftUI view state.
Changing a definition produces a previewable instance impact set and never overwrites local overrides silently.
Imported repo components can be represented as locked source definitions with Board-local variants/overrides until a later proposal is accepted.
Detach is explicit, undoable, and records provenance; detached objects no longer pretend to track the source component.
A stress fixture covers nested instances, variant swaps, missing source revision, cyclic definition rejection, large instance counts, and migration from freeform artboard objects.
The new boundary is represented by explicit typed models or protocols and is not hidden inside a view, global singleton, or loosely typed metadata dictionary.
Deterministic tests cover the normal path plus stale, missing, invalid, offline, and recovery behavior appropriate to the capability.
Migration and compatibility behavior is explicit; existing persisted or exported data either continues to load or fails with an actionable unsupported-version state.
The implementation records before-and-after architecture evidence and names any intentionally retained compatibility surface or follow-up.
The strongest practical repository-native build, test, lint, contract, and diff gates pass with zero app-owned warnings; warnings are not hidden by suppression or threshold changes.

evidence.note: BoardCore provides the tested platform-independent domain boundary.
Versioned document persistence is required for definitions and migrations.
All instance edits must flow through commands and history.
Linked screen artboards provide the primary consumer for component instances.
Imported components/views already retain stable IDs and source evidence.

agent_notes: Portfolio Evolution Wave 2; technical north-star ticket.
Estimated effort: XL, 6-10 focused working days

User outcome: A designer can place one real project component across several screens, update shared properties intentionally, override only allowed fields, and see which instances drift from the source contract.
Non-scope: Do not implement every CSS/Auto Layout behavior, real-time collaboration, or direct SwiftUI source rewrite.
Alternative considered and rejected: Treat repeated elements as copied groups — copies cannot preserve shared identity, controlled overrides, source drift, or impact previews.
Do not broaden the slice into unrelated cleanup, framework migration, release publication, or source-of-truth changes outside the ticket.
